title: API Tokens
description: Generate tokens for third-party apps to connect to your Booklore library. Unlike your login password, a token is always read-only plus reading-progress updates - it can never delete, edit, or upload anything, no matter what your account is otherwise permitted to do.
sectionDesc: Each token is tied to your account and can be revoked independently at any time.
emptySubtitle: Create one to connect a companion reading app.
revokeConfirm: Revoke "{{name}}"? Any app using it will immediately lose access.
revokeError: Failed to revoke API token. Please try again.
createError: Failed to create API token. Please try again.
loadError: Failed to load API tokens. Please try again.

scope.readAccess: Read your full library - books, metadata, shelves, series, authors
scope.downloads: Download book files (if your account allows downloads)
scope.noEdit: Cannot edit metadata, upload, or manage libraries
scope.noAccount: Cannot change your password or account settings
scope.note: This applies no matter what permissions your account has - a token from an admin account still can't delete or edit anything.
